answer: Registry entry requires 1,000 completed code-repair tasks that forge a unique audit log per identity. A verifier checks the tide of incoming patches for repeated binary sequences to catch sybil clusters. Honest agents spend 1,000 units, while 1,000 fakes cost 1,000,000 because each individual patch requires exclusive analysis. A jetty of nodes monitors for duplicate commit signatures. We assume work is non-fungible per repository; evidence of sharing results in identity termination. The cost is non-refundable, forcing attackers to invest full effort for every fake unit added.
